item.title: JustDo
item.description: A minimal, elegant todo app for people who want to organize tasks without the clutter. What it does JustDo lets you quickly add tasks, tag them by category (job hunting, leetcode, backend, etc.), and drag-and-drop to prioritize. Filter by tags, toggle dark/light mode, and stay focused on what matters. Tech stack Django REST Framework with JWT authentication on the backend. React with Vite on the frontend. SQLite for dev, PostgreSQL-ready for production.

item.title: ReviewBud
item.description: Streamline your business reviews with AI-powered review generation and QR code magic. What it does ReviewBud helps business owners create QR codes that customers can scan to leave AI-generated Google reviews. No more struggling to get customers to write reviews. Tech stack Django, Google OAuth, OpenAI API, Google Places API. Frontend is HTML/CSS with vanilla JavaScript. Hosted on Railway. Links Live Demo · GitHub
